procedure.devnotes:
Old built-in input paths now refer to the relocated, typed files. FromSource selected from parameter input means explicit XY roots. Preserve the requested distribution instead of silently generating a lattice. Use the filename extension for both current and legacy file modes. Initialize the shared computational geometry before locating roots. there are four options for defining the location and number of roots rasterdatafile: root counts within a pre defined grid are input xyfile: a list of defined roots with their exact position input inppar: only the average root length density is defined, the root position are then calculated either in a regular hexagonal grid or as pure random positions submodstruct: the positions are given by a root structural model
Only a distribution change starts a new random realization. Init may reset hydraulic states repeatedly while retaining root geometry. Legacy observation-window diagnostics; margin roots may still transport water/nitrate.
